005package org.wpilib.epilogue;
006
007import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.ServiceLoader;
010import java.util.function.Consumer;
011import org.wpilib.driverstation.DriverStationErrors;
012import org.wpilib.framework.RobotBase;
013import org.wpilib.framework.TimedRobot;
014import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
015import org.wpilib.util.container.WeakLinkedHashSet;
016
017/** Main entry point for using Epilogue telemetry at runtime. */
018public final class Epilogue {
019  private Epilogue() {}
020
021  @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
022  private static final Map<Object, EpilogueService> s_loggers = new IdentityHashMap<>();
023
024  private static final WeakLinkedHashSet<Object> s_knownUnloggable = new WeakLinkedHashSet<>();
025
026  @SuppressWarnings({"rawtypes", "PMD.UseProperClassLoader"})
027  private static final ServiceLoader<EpilogueService> s_loader =
028      ServiceLoader.load(EpilogueService.class, Epilogue.class.getClassLoader());
029
030  private static final EpilogueConfiguration s_config = new EpilogueConfiguration();
031
032  /**
033   * Applies a configuration function to the current configuration. The full set of options can be
034   * seen in {@link EpilogueConfiguration}.
035   *
036   * {@snippet lang="java":
037   * Epilogue.configure(config -> {
038   *   config.root = "Custom Telemetry Root";
039   *   // ... among other options
040   * });
041   * }
042   *
043   * @param configurator the configuration function to apply
044   * @see EpilogueConfiguration the full set of configurable options
045   */
046  public static void configure(Consumer<EpilogueConfiguration> configurator) {
047    configurator.accept(s_config);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Gets the current set of config options.
052   *
053   * @return the current configuration object
054   */
055  public static EpilogueConfiguration getConfig() {
056    return s_config;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Checks if data associated with a given importance level should be logged.
061   *
062   * @param importance the importance level to check
063   * @return true if the importance level is at or above the configured minimum
064   * @see EpilogueConfiguration#minimumImportance
065   * @see #configure(Consumer)
066   */
067  public static boolean shouldLog(Logged.Importance importance) {
068    return importance.compareTo(s_config.minimumImportance) >= 0;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Updates telemetry for the specified robot instance. Call this in a periodic method like {@link
073   * TimedRobot#robotPeriodic()}.
074   *
075   * {@snippet lang="java":
076   * import module wpilib;
077   *
078   * @Logged
079   * public class Robot extends TimedRobot {
080   *   @Override
081   *   public void robotPeriodic() {
082   *     Epilogue.update(this);
083   *   }
084   * }
085   * }
086   *
087   * @param <R> the robot type
088   * @param robot the robot instance to update
089   * @return true if telemetry was updated, false otherwise
090   */
091  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
092  public static <R extends RobotBase> boolean update(R robot) {
093    if (s_knownUnloggable.contains(robot)) {
094      // We already know this will fail, so we can skip the rest of the method.
095      return false;
096    }
097
098    if (missingLogger(robot)) {
099      s_loader.stream()
100          .map(ServiceLoader.Provider::get)
101          .filter(s -> s.supportsExactly(robot))
102          .findFirst()
103          .ifPresent(service -> s_loggers.put(robot, service));
104    }
105    if (missingLogger(robot)) {
106      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(buildMissingLoggerMessage(robot), false);
107      s_knownUnloggable.add(robot);
108      return false;
109    } else {
110      UsageReporting.reportUsage("Epilogue", "update");
111    }
112
113    s_loggers.get(robot).update(robot);
114    return true;
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Binds periodic telemetry updates to the specified timed robot. Updates will execute at the
119   * frequency specified in {@link #getConfig()}, with a phase offset of {@link
120   * EpilogueConfiguration#loggingPeriodOffset} to avoid collisions with the main robot task.
121   *
122   * <p>This method is offered as a convenience for setting up telemetry in the robot constructor;
123   * it is not required to use Epilogue. Calling {@link #update(RobotBase)} in {@link
124   * TimedRobot#robotPeriodic()} would also work and would provide better timing control without
125   * phase offsets.
126   *
127   * {@snippet lang="java":
128   * import module wpilib;
129   *
130   * @Logged
131   * public class Robot extends TimedRobot {
132   *   public Robot() {
133   *      Epilogue.bind(this);
134   *   }
135   * }
136   * }
137   *
138   * @param <R> the timed robot type
139   * @param robot the timed robot instance to bind
140   * @return true if a matching bindable logger service was found and bound, false otherwise
141   */
142  @SuppressWarnings({"unchecked", "rawtypes"})
143  public static <R extends TimedRobot> boolean bind(R robot) {
144    var maybeLogger =
145        s_loader.stream()
146            .filter(s -> EpilogueService.Bindable.class.isAssignableFrom(s.type()))
147            .map(ServiceLoader.Provider::get)
148            .filter(s -> s.supportsExactly(robot))
149            .findFirst();
150
151    if (maybeLogger.isPresent()) {
152      // The cast should always be safe because we checked the type in the stream above
153      var logger = (EpilogueService.Bindable<R>) maybeLogger.get();
154      logger.bind(robot);
155      s_loggers.put(robot, logger);
156      UsageReporting.reportUsage("Epilogue", "bind");
157      return true;
158    } else {
159      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(buildMissingLoggerMessage(robot), false);
160      s_knownUnloggable.add(robot);
161      return false;
162    }
163  }
164
165  private static boolean missingLogger(Object robot) {
166    return !s_loggers.containsKey(robot);
167  }
168
169  private static String buildMissingLoggerMessage(RobotBase robot) {
170    StringBuilder msg =
171        new StringBuilder(256)
172            .append("[EPILOGUE] No logger was found for ")
173            .append(robot.getClass().getName())
174            .append('.');
175    if (!robot.getClass().isAnnotationPresent(Logged.class)) {
176      msg.append(" Does the class have a @Logged annotation?");
177    }
178    if (robot.getClass().getModule() != null) {
179      msg.append(
180              " Ensure module-info.java has a `provides org.wpilib.epilogue.EpilogueService with ")
181          .append(robot.getClass().getName())
182          .append("_EpilogueService` statement.");
183    }
184    return msg.toString();
185  }
186}
